Middle third gradually enters a moonblue natural root cavern with cyan mushrooms, violet crystals and silver waterfalls. Right third gradually reveals an amber crystal cavern, deep purple basalt, turquoise waterfall and tiny distant orange lavafall. All three share one continuous canyon with interlocking winding roots and rock arches, matching horizon, scale and atmospheric depth. Absolutely NO panels, dividing lines, separate scenes, dissolve, abrupt palette bands, tiled collage or duplicated landmarks. The artwork flows organically left to right. Broad distant arches and foliage; lower middle 40%-85% of height soft mid-distance with enough open air for actual runtime platforms/characters. Upper edge canopy/root shapes, lower edge distant river. No foreground ground strip or platforms, no walkable surfaces, HUD, numbers, characters, enemies, apples, labels. Rich tactile brushwork with coherent shape language, joyful saturated animated adventure quality, no flat geometric blocks. Detailed yet clear, not fog covering everything.
